name: FleetPilot
description: Self-hosted operations dashboard for home labs and small companies: server updates, SMART disk health, routers (FRITZ!Box, OpenWrt, OPNsense, pfSense, MikroTik), Proxmox VMs, TrueNAS/Unraid storage, backup servers and fans, managed over SSH and APIs without agents.

notes.text: The admin password is generated on first start: `cat /opt/fleetpilot/data/initial_admin_password`. Change it after signing in and delete that file.
FleetPilot uses a self-signed certificate. Open https://<container-ip> and accept the certificate once.
FleetPilot signs in to the servers it manages with the key in /root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub. Add that key to the servers, or use Manage Hosts → Install Key.
Update FleetPilot with the update command of this script in the Proxmox shell. The in-app 'FleetPilot update' page needs a git checkout and does not apply to this container.
